groups.name: BirdLife Jamaica
groups.blurb: The BirdLife International partner and national bird society, formerly the Gosse Bird Club, promoting bird conservation through fieldwork and education.

groups.name: Trinidad and Tobago Field Naturalists Club
groups.blurb: Natural history society founded in 1891, with 250 members organising monthly field excursions and publishing the journal Living World.

groups.name: Sociedad Ornitológica Puertorriqueña
groups.blurb: BirdLife partner founded 1995, dedicated to bird conservation with public workshops, field walks and the Cambalache Forest Ornithological Center.

name: Dominican Republic
gaps: Sociedad Ornitológica de la Hispaniola operates across both Haiti and Dominican Republic but has no independently verifiable website.

groups.name: Grupo Jaragua
groups.blurb: Biodiversity conservation organisation founded 1987, managing the Jaragua, Bahoruco and Enriquillo Biosphere Reserve with research and community programmes.

name: Haiti
gaps: Audubon Society of Haiti and Sociedad Ornitológica de la Hispaniola both operate in Haiti but lack easily accessible websites; the latter primarily coordinates from Dominican Republic.

groups.name: Bahamas National Trust
groups.blurb: National park authority managing 32 protected areas and delivering birding tours, training local guides and supporting citizen science.

name: Barbados
gaps: Barbados Wildfowl and Wetland Trust is mentioned in conservation discussions but has no independently verifiable website.

groups.name: Barbados National Trust
groups.blurb: Heritage and nature conservation organisation managing reserves and historic sites, with active birding and wetlands conservation programmes.

groups.name: National Trust for the Cayman Islands
groups.blurb: Biodiversity and heritage conservation charity established 1987, managing sanctuaries and operating Tuesday morning Focus on Birding walks.

name: Cuba
gaps: Sociedad Cubana de Zoología has an Ornithology Section and publishes the Anuario Ornitológico de Cuba but has no direct website.

groups.name: Bermuda Audubon Society
groups.blurb: Volunteer led society providing bird identification resources, BirdTrax tracking website and seasonal birding information for island residents.

groups.name: Environmental Awareness Group
groups.blurb: NGO established 1989 working with birders on education, conservation and island restoration, with active Facebook community engagement.

name: Dominica
gaps: No dedicated local birding club or ornithological society found with independent operations; conservation work led by international partners like Rare Species Conservatory Foundation.

groups.name: Gaea Conservation Network
groups.blurb: Conservation organisation running the Grenada Birding Club, organising field trips, workshops and citizen science monitoring across the island.

name: Saint Lucia
gaps: No independent local birding club or conservation society found; birding activity primarily through commercial tour operators.

name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
gaps: Saint Vincent National Trust manages heritage but no dedicated birding club or ornithological society found with public membership.

groups.name: Birds of St. Kitts and Nevis
groups.blurb: Community birding resource by amateur birders documenting local species and trip reports, facilitating shared sightings and field guide information.

groups.name: Aruba Birdlife Conservation
groups.blurb: Nature conservation foundation founded 2010, protecting endemic and migratory bird species through education and habitat preservation projects.

groups.name: Bird Watching Curaçao
groups.blurb: Volunteer project recording island sightings on eBird, running birding hikes and school education programmes.

name: British Virgin Islands
gaps: No dedicated local birding club found; National Parks Trust manages bird habitats but does not operate as a membership birding community.

groups.name: Virgin Islands Audubon Society
groups.blurb: Audubon chapter based on St. John providing conservation education, organising Christmas Bird Counts and coordinating breeding bird surveys.

groups.name: Turks and Caicos National Trust
groups.blurb: Heritage conservation body established 1992, managing national parks and protecting natural resources including bird habitats and sanctuaries.

groups.name: Montserrat National Trust
groups.blurb: Environmental and heritage conservation organisation managing protected areas and coordinates guided walks for birders seeking endemic Montserrat Oriole.

name: Anguilla
gaps: No dedicated local birding club or ornithological society found; birding activity primarily through informal guides and commercial tour operators.
